brand.naming_note: Working names. Sagely is close to the many existing 'Sage' names in finance, so a trademark attorney must clear it before launch, and domain availability is unchecked. 'Entry Optimizer' can read as promising the best entry; the copy therefore says plainly that you can still buy at the strike while the stock keeps falling.
brand.subtitle: Data Driven Investing
brand.transparency: Every number comes from a statistical method and assumptions we publish. We show the mathematical worst case first, compare each idea with what a short-term Treasury bill would pay, log every pick, and make no predictions. Statistics describe odds, not results. That openness is rare in options writing.
brand.repeat_short: Collect the rent again and again.
brand.repeat: You can repeat Rent Check and Entry Optimizer every cycle. Keep the shares and collect rent again, or keep waiting and get paid again. It is a process, not a one-off trade. Amounts change, statistics describe odds and do not promise results, and a stock that keeps falling still costs you.
brand.repeat_card: You can do this again next cycle if you keep the shares (or keep waiting). Next cycle's amount may be higher or lower.
brand.corrections: Found a mistake? Reply and tell us. We fix errors in the next issue, say so at the top, and correct the track-record page. We do not quietly edit past results.

universe.exclude_note: Defense and aerospace names are left out by default to avoid any employer overlap. Add your employer, competitors, teaming partners and any name you have non-public information about to 'exclude', and pre-clear the final list with your employer's ethics/compliance office. Option liquidity for this universe has not been validated: run the screen and review what is skipped.
